context:
Goal: buttons read the same everywhere.
Problem (rule): the pinned Vercel rules ask for Title Case; the repo uses sentence case ("New envelope").
Based on (read): every built button is sentence case.
Departs from: main's sentence case — option b moves every button to Title Case.
Asked by lane duo-gaps-design-review (PR 237, mockup docs/design/duo-hand-gaps.html). The picks per part live in docs/design/duo-hand-gaps-notes.md.

options.how: Every button stays as built, such as "New envelope".
options.label: Keep sentence case
options.lose: It differs from the external list.

options.how: Every button label changes, such as "New Envelope".
options.label: Title Case
options.lose: Every built label changes, outside this lane's scope.

title: Buttons: keep sentence case ("New envelope"), or move to Title Case?
why: The whole app already reads one way; changing it buys only a match with an outside list.
